histology: invasive ductal carcinoma, no special type, triple-negative; basal-like by molecular subtyping
stage: cT2-3 cN1 cM1 — newly diagnosed; right breast primary with ipsilateral axillary nodal involvement and a solitary 1.5cm hepatic lesion consistent with oligometastatic de novo M1 disease (liver-only single-site)

biomarkers.name: BRCA1
biomarkers.value: mutated; germline vs somatic not specified
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Germline-vs-somatic determination required to guide risk-reducing surgery and cascade genetic testing; however, somatic BRCA1 is still PARP-inhibitor actionable so PARP-i actionability is not gated on this distinction.

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Functionally informative for TP53-dependent stratification (e.g. WEE1 inhibitor rationale); not directly drug-gating.

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Specific hotspot variant (E542K/E545K/H1047R vs non-hotspot) needed to confirm alpelisib actionability per FDA label; capivasertib indication also relies on PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alteration confirmation.

biomarkers.name: MYC amplification
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Informs BET inhibitors, CDK7/9 inhibitors, and transcriptional-addiction approaches; primarily trial-territory.

biomarkers.name: IRS2 amplification
biomarkers.decision_resolution: IGF-1R / IRS signaling axis rationale; experimental — trial-territory only.

biomarkers.name: PTEN
biomarkers.decision_resolution: PI3K/AKT pathway axis; reinforces AKT-inhibitor (capivasertib) rationale, potentially synergistic with PIK3CA-mut.

biomarkers.name: Intrinsic molecular subtype
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Basal-specific therapeutic strategies (TROP2-ADC sacituzumab govitecan, datopotamab-deruxtecan; ICI combos in basal/TIL-rich tumors).

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Meets ≥10 mut/Mb threshold for tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-158 label).

biomarkers.name: MSI status
biomarkers.decision_resolution: MSS — does not qualify for MSI-H/dMMR tumor-agnostic ICI indication; TMB-H pathway remains.

biomarkers.name: Stromal TILs
biomarkers.method: H&E review per International TILs Working Group
biomarkers.decision_resolution: High TIL infiltration is favorable to ICI-containing strategies; reinforces KEYNOTE-522 / IMpassion-style neoadjuvant ICI + chemo backbone.

biomarkers.name: HER2
biomarkers.method: IHC with reflex FISH if equivocal
biomarkers.decision_resolution: HER2 0 vs HER2-low (1+ / 2+ FISH-) distinction would gate trastuzumab-deruxtecan eligibility under DESTINY-Breast04/06; not specified here.

targetable_features.rationale: PARP-inhibitor (olaparib per OlympiAD, talazoparib per EMBRACA) actionability in BRCA1/2-mutated HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; also predicts platinum sensitivity (carboplatin/cisplatin preference in TNBC backbone, e.g. TNT trial signal in BRCA-mut subset).

Not directly targetable but functionally relevant — TP53-loss / replication-stress phenotype informs WEE1 inhibitor rationale (e.g. adavosertib) and supports DNA-damaging backbones (platinum, PARP-i).

PI3Kα-inhibitor (alpelisib; inavolisib) rationale, with capivasertib (pan-AKT) specifically studied in PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered HR+ breast cancer (CAPItello-291); TNBC PIK3CA-mut evidence is more limited but is an active trial space.
Drives transcriptional addiction; informs BET-bromodomain inhibitors, CDK7/CDK9 inhibitors, and selected MYC-pathway approaches — predominantly clinical-trial territory.
IGF-1R / IRS signaling axis; experimental rationale for IGF-1R-axis agents — trial-only at present.
Activates PI3K/AKT pathway (synergistic with PIK3CA-mut); reinforces AKT-inhibitor (capivasertib) rationale and dual PI3K/AKT-pathway combinations.

Basal-specific strategies — TROP2-directed ADC sacituzumab govitecan (ASCENT) and datopotamab-deruxtecan (TROPION-Breast02 in 1L mTNBC); immune-checkpoint combinations show enrichment in basal/TIL-rich tumors.
Meets ≥10 mut/Mb threshold for tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab indication (KEYNOTE-158); ICI rationale further reinforced by 3+ stromal TILs.

High TILs are an established positive predictive marker for ICI benefit and pCR with KEYNOTE-522-style neoadjuvant pembrolizumab + chemotherapy; also IMpassion-style atezolizumab + nab-paclitaxel signal in PD-L1+ TNBC.
